newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: DMCI to issue convertible preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: DMCI to issue convertible preferred shares.

text.p: Construction firm DMCI Holdings Inc said on Wednesday its board had approved a resolution that DMCI should issue up to 2.4 million convertible preferred shares at an offer price of 1,000 pesos each.
The shares, which are redeemable, non-voting and non-participating, have a par value of one peso each.
The board also agreed to issue 150 million underlying common shares with a par value of one peso each.
The conversion price will be 10 to 15 percent over the average closing price of the common shares five days prior to the pricing date.
Other details were not immediately available.
DMCI closed 50 centavos up at 18 pesos on Wednesday.
